posts.title: Human-like isn't the same as good: Rethinking Conversational AI's North Star
posts.description: There's an assumption baked into most conversational AI roadmaps that nobody really questions anymore: more human-like is better. Friendlier persona, more natural turn-taking, more emotional mirroring, all treated as obvious improvements, the same way "more accurate" or "faster" would be. But is that actually true? posts.title: Text is the new interface and not everyone speaks it well
posts.description: For most of computing history, the interface stood between you and the machine, and good UX meant designing that interface so a user's skill level stopped mattering much. LLMs quietly broke that deal.
